Create tile from project.

Source: R/method_Tile.R
create_tile_from_project.Rd

Create a new_tile() object from a [new_project() object.

Usage

create_tile_from_project(
  x,
  column,
  source_layer = "layer",
  path = tempfile(fileext = ".pmtiles"),
  max_zoom = 8,
  engine = get_golem_config("tile_engine"),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

new_project() object.

column

character value with column name.

source_layer

character value with name for layer in PMTiles archive. Defaults to "data-src".

path

character value with file path for PMTiles archive. Note that path must have a ".pmtiles" file extension. Defaults to a temporary file path.

max_zoom

integer value with maximum zoom level. Defaults to 8.

engine

character value denoting the engine for processing the the tiles. Available options include "r" or "rust". Defaults to get_golem_config("tile_engine").

verbose

logical value indicating if information about tile creation should be displayed? Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A new_tile() object.

See also

Other functions for calling class methods: create_dataset_from_sf(), create_legend(), create_solution(), create_solution_from_prioritization(), create_solution_legend(), create_tile_from_file(), create_tile_from_sf(), new_dataset(), tool_generated_provenance()

Examples

# simulate project
sim_project <- simulate_project()

# create tile
x <- create_tile_from_project(
  sim_project,
  column = "solution"
)

# preview object
print(x)
#> A <Tile> object.
